content_blocks.steps_heading: Your Path to CAPM Certification in Orlando

steps_items.heading: Confirm Your Eligibility
steps_items.text: CAPM requires a secondary degree and completion of project management education hours—no prior work experience needed. This makes CAPM ideal for career-changers and professionals new to project management. Verify your education credentials meet PMI requirements before enrolling.

steps_items.heading: Complete 23 Contact Hours of Education
steps_items.text: Enroll in Granite PM Academy's live-virtual, instructor-led boot-camp course. Our intensive format compresses the required contact hours into a focused learning experience, delivered entirely online so you can study from anywhere in the Orlando area while maintaining your current schedule.

steps_items.heading: Submit Your PMI Application
steps_items.text: After course completion, submit your official PMI application, including proof of education hours and your secondary degree. Pay the exam registration fee directly to PMI. Our training team guides you through each requirement to ensure your application is complete and accepted.

steps_items.heading: Prepare and Sit for the Exam
steps_items.text: Access Granite PM Academy's exam-preparation resources and practice materials to reinforce CAPM knowledge domains. Schedule your proctored exam when ready. Our instructors remain available to answer final questions before you test, maximizing your readiness on exam day.

steps_items.heading: Maintain Your CAPM Credential
steps_items.text: After certification, earn professional development units (PDUs) across a three-year renewal cycle to keep your credential active. Participate in continuing education, webinars, and project management activities aligned with PMI standards. Granite PM Academy offers PDU opportunities to support your ongoing professional growth.

fq_items.question: Do I need project management experience to take the CAPM?
fq_items.answer: No prior PM experience is required. The CAPM only requires secondary education (high school diploma or equivalent) and 23 contact hours of project management education — which our course fulfills.

fq_items.question: Is the CAPM a good starting credential for {city} professionals?

fq_items.question: How does the CAPM differ from the PMP?
fq_items.answer: The PMP requires 36–60 months of project leadership experience; the CAPM does not. Many professionals earn the CAPM early in their career, gain experience, then pursue the PMP.
